run_f_gold: run f_gold(n) to compute the sum of absolute differences between row and column indices for an n by n matrix
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled by running the main block with parameter sets to verify correctness
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which calculates 2 times the sum of i*(n-i) for i from 0 to n-1
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the loop with a closed-form formula for better performance
create_f_filled: create f_filled as a candidate implementation that matches the output of f_gold for all test cases
